acceptance.negative: An exact rational vector must have a strictly negative interval quadratic-form upper endpoint against the retained intersection.
acceptance.positive: All 401 streaming interval LDL pivots must have strictly positive lower endpoints at both source precision levels.
acceptance.unresolved: Any pivot interval containing zero stops the run without a sign claim.

pipeline.cross_intersection: Generate each dual-route and transpose-aware intersection tile immediately after its four source tiles are available.
pipeline.factorization: Run the disk-backed 64 by 64 Schur factorizer once on the 9000-bit low intersection and once on the 9512-bit high intersection.
pipeline.route_generation: Precompute only one-dimensional formula data, evaluate one 64 by 64 route tile at a time, serialize rigorous endpoints, and release the tile before evaluating the next tile.

provenance.scope: These records bind the registered parameters and same-route positive inertia only; they are not high-precision dual-route matrix evidence.

resource_policy.note: This is a conservative execution budget, not a mathematical bound.
